nativeStreamer.title: Native Streamer
nativeStreamer.runtimeDescription: Enable the experimental streamer and inspect its local native runtime readiness.
nativeStreamer.videoOutputDescription: Hardware capability, rendering backend, frame pacing, and window mode.
nativeStreamer.nativeStreamingHint: Native streaming is experimental and may have platform-specific bugs, glitches, or fallbacks to Chromium/WebRTC. Enable it only if you are comfortable testing the self-contained desktop streamer for new sessions.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptBody: The native streamer is still experimental. Internal mode keeps video inside the OpenNOW window; external floating mode is available as a fallback in settings.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptNewSessions: Native streaming applies to new sessions only.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptShortcuts: In internal mode, OpenNOW shortcuts stay available. External floating mode captures input in its own window.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptAltTab: If you use external floating mode, Alt+Tab back into OpenNOW to exit the stream or use app shortcuts.
nativeStreamer.showNativeStreamerStatsHint: Display the native streamer's own diagnostics overlay during native sessions.
nativeStreamer.statusDefaultHint: OpenNOW will check the bundled native streamer when this tab opens.
nativeStreamer.runtimeDefaultHint: Packaged Windows/macOS builds auto-detect a bundled runtime next to the native streamer. Linux uses distro packages.
nativeStreamer.noCodecsAvailable: No compatible codecs were detected for this backend.
nativeStreamer.capabilityProbeHint: Refresh the streamer status to probe the video backends supported by this PC.
nativeStreamer.backendUnavailableOnPc: This backend is not supported by the installed native runtime and GPU drivers.
nativeStreamer.videoPathDefaultHint: OpenNOW will show the active hardware decode path after the native runtime is detected.
nativeStreamer.directxBackendHint: Applies to the next native streamer process. Unsupported choices are disabled from the live capability probe. Auto selects the best compatible path.
nativeStreamer.framePacingHint: Lowest Latency avoids G-Sync pacing and is best for mouse feel. Smooth G-Sync can reduce tearing, but may cap rendering to the monitor refresh rate.
nativeStreamer.renderModeHint: Internal embeds native video in the OpenNOW window. External uses the native presenter's own window. The change applies to the next native streamer process.
nativeStreamer.renderModeExternalRequiredHint: macOS uses a standalone native window because AppKit views cannot be embedded across the Electron and streamer processes. Keyboard and mouse input are captured by that window.
nativeStreamer.renderModeInternalOnlyHint: This platform uses Internal (one window) only. Keyboard, mouse, and controller input stay in Electron and are forwarded over IPC.
nativeStreamer.transportModeHint: WebRTC uses Chromium for media. NVST sends H.264 video through the native UDP/SRTP decoder while audio and input continue over WebRTC. Select NVST to test native hardware video decoding.
nativeStreamer.transportModeWindowsOnlyHint: NVST transport is Windows-only for now. This platform always uses WebRTC.
